title: acantholimon tragacanthinum
intro: Acantholimon tragacanthinum, commonly known as the 'Gypsophila of the Mountains', is a plant species belonging to the Plumbaginaceae family. The health benefits of Acantholimon tragacanthinum include its potential to alleviate coughs and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties, as well as its use in treating gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to act as a demulcent and a soothing agent, which helps to protect and calm irritated mucous membranes. Acantholimon tragacanthinum contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
